note: Synthetic durable memories for the retrieval regression probe. Topics mirror public Brain design notes but the wording is fixture-only; nothing here is a product claim. Near-duplicate entries are deliberate distractors so ranking, not just presence, is measured.

facts.text: The brief command emits facts and history before the status block so agents that truncate long packets still see the evidence first.
A brief status block that grows past about ten kilobytes crowds out evidence; keep status after facts and history and trim it to counts.
Agent guides name recall, not query, as the command for prior decisions because query ranks docs and facts together.
Query expansion stays opt-in: an early effect of d 0.47 at n 8 collapsed to d 0.10 with p 0.26 at n 121.
BM25 over tokenized history replaced substring matching as the default ranker after a 2.7x to 5.1x useful-per-1k gain across strata.
Model2Vec fusion on history was dropped: precision was significantly worse than BM25 at production scale and the small-repo gain was noise.
Reciprocal rank fusion keeps equal weights and k0 of 60; a weight sweep put every cell inside noise.
Locus-scoped fact retrieval shipped because it cut 112 tokens per query with a recall cost of 0.029; the outline stays a map, not a ranker.
A scoped-floor arm built from backfilled facts was a dead end and must not be revived without a new task set.
Durable facts are scoped to a branch; recall and brief on a feature branch see no main-branch facts unless --branch main is passed.
A fact id is derived from its content, so the same memory recorded in two fresh stores receives the same id.
When a feature branch merges, memories promote carries its active facts into the target branch instead of re-recording them.
Canonical facts and manifests stay separate from derived SQLite and FTS caches; a derived cache may be rebuilt, canonical data may not be regenerated.
Every fact store write takes the brain write lock and publishes atomically so a concurrent distill cannot interleave half-written records.
The distill cache key is salted with agent, model and effort; dropping the salt made runs with different judges share stale verdicts.
Batch distill admits a fact only above a strict quality gate rather than capturing every turn, so the fact layer stays small and precise.
MCP tool calls resolve relative paths inside the bound repository root and refuse cross-repository reads unless ENTIRE_BRAIN_MCP_ALLOW_ANY_PATH is set.
The MCP server handles tool calls sequentially, so one unbounded provider call blocks every later call until its deadline fires.
Retained benchmark evidence defaults to no_release_claim; a citable result needs at least four runs per side against current task definitions and must survive drop-one.
Confirmatory arms compare no_memory, placebo_packet and retrieved_memory with an identical instruction that differs only inside the frozen packet.
The memory ladder demo question must have a rationale that lives only in session history, because Brain ingests live sessions and anything discussed today contaminates tomorrow.

Semantic retrieval and the embedder type were removed after an in-process lexical ranker matched the embedder stack on recall while cutting agent tokens 18 to 28 percent and 31 megabytes off every binary.
Checkpoint export filters ignored and private paths before any transcript leaves the machine; a disclosure cannot be recalled.
Benchmark clones run with lifecycle hooks swallowed so a nested agent run never captures a checkpoint into the real repository.
